title: Stylish Nashville Retreat | Near Downtown| Nissan
description:
Escape to a stylish, comfortable home base perfectly positioned for exploring Music City. This 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home puts you just a short drive from all the honky-tonks, museums, and iconic venues that make Nashville famous, while letting you unwind in a quiet residential neighborhood at the end of the day. Just a short drive from renowned music venues like the Grand Ole Opry, the Broadway district, and local eateries and music venues.

The space
House can comfortably accommodate 6-7 people

Sleeping arrangements:
1st bedroom has 1 Queen Bed
2nd bedroom has 1 queen and 1 single bed
Living room has a double pull out bed
